title: Giving Opinions
ringkas: Menyatakan pendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju
goals: menyatakan pendapat: [[I think ...]], [[In my opinion, ...]], [[I believe ...]]
menyatakan setuju dan tidak setuju dengan sopan
memberi alasan dengan [[because]] dan akibat dengan [[so]]
menyusun opini pendek yang jelas: pendapat, alasan, kesimpulan

lesson.text: Apakah seragam sekolah sebaiknya dipertahankan? Apakah bermain game itu baik? Setiap orang bisa punya pendapat berbeda. Di **Unit 6 Kelas 9** kamu belajar **menyampaikan pendapat**, **setuju atau tidak setuju**, dan **memberi alasan** dengan sopan.

lesson.title: 1. Menyatakan pendapat
table: [[In my opinion, homework is too much.]]
[[As far as I'm concerned, sports are healthy.]]
[[It seems to me that we need more time.]]

lesson.title: 2. Setuju dan tidak setuju
table: Aku juga berpikir begitu. / Kamu benar sekali.
Aku setuju sebagian, tapi ... / Itu benar, tapi ...
[[I'm not sure about that.]] / [[I see your point, but ...]]
Aku kurang yakin. / Aku paham maksudmu, tapi ...

lesson.title: Tidak setuju dengan sopan
lesson.text: Jangan langsung bilang "No, you're wrong!". Mulailah dengan menghargai: [[I see your point, but I think ...]] atau [[That's an interesting idea, but ...]] Lalu beri **alasan**.

lesson.title: 3. Alasan dan akibat
table: [[I like English because it is fun.]]
[[It was raining, so we stayed home.]]
[[The movie was long, but it was interesting.]]
[[Games are fun. However, they can waste time.]]
[[Exercise is good for health. It also makes us happy.]]
[[Many sports are fun, for example, football and badminton.]]

lesson.title: 4. Struktur opini pendek
table: [[First, uniforms make all students equal. Second, they save time in the morning.]]
[[So, I believe uniforms are good for students.]]

lines.en: In my opinion, school uniforms are useful. They make all students look equal.
lines.id: Menurutku, seragam sekolah bermanfaat. Seragam membuat semua siswa terlihat setara.

lines.en: I see your point, but I don't agree completely. Uniforms are sometimes uncomfortable.
lines.id: Aku paham maksudmu, tapi aku tidak sepenuhnya setuju. Seragam kadang tidak nyaman.

lines.en: That's true. However, they also save time in the morning because we don't need to choose clothes.
lines.id: Itu benar. Namun seragam juga menghemat waktu di pagi hari karena kita tidak perlu memilih baju.

lines.en: Hmm, I agree with that. So maybe uniforms are good, but they should be comfortable.
lines.id: Hmm, aku setuju soal itu. Jadi mungkin seragam itu baik, tapi harus nyaman.

lesson.title: Contoh opini: Should students bring phones to school?

lines.en: I think students shouldn't bring phones to school.
lines.id: Menurutku siswa sebaiknya tidak membawa ponsel ke sekolah. (Statement)

lines.en: First, phones can distract students in class. Second, some students may play games instead of studying.
lines.id: Pertama, ponsel bisa mengganggu konsentrasi di kelas. Kedua, sebagian siswa bisa bermain game, bukan belajar. (Reasons)

lines.en: However, phones can be useful in an emergency. So students may bring them, but they must keep them in their bags during lessons.
lines.id: Namun ponsel berguna saat darurat. Jadi siswa boleh membawanya, tetapi harus disimpan di tas saat pelajaran. (Conclusion)

items: Setuju: [[I agree.]] / [[Exactly!]]. Tidak setuju: [[I don't agree.]], sebaiknya dengan sopan: [[I see your point, but ...]]
